## Summary

## Verification

List the exact commands you ran and their results.

## Checklist

- [ ] I kept simulation, persistence, narrative, API, and frontend boundaries intact.
- [ ] Narrative-generated effects still pass through deterministic validation and caps.
- [ ] Important choice resolution remains idempotent and snapshots remain immutable.
- [ ] Mock narrative mode works without an API key.
- [ ] I added or updated relevant tests.
- [ ] I ran the applicable test, lint, formatting, type-check, migration, and build commands.
- [ ] I updated documentation and `docs/PROGRESS.md` when behavior or project status changed.
- [ ] I did not commit secrets, local databases, generated output, or private profile data.
